lines.japanese: 「ああ……うん、なんていうか、今日はせっかく四人揃うと思ったのに、残念だなって」
lines.english: “Oh... It’s nothing. I was just thinking what a shame it is. I really thought all four of us would finally be together today.”

lines.japanese: 「そうだね、明日は渡来さん来てくれるといいね。昔から、彼女がいるところはそれだけで場が華やぐから」
lines.english: “It is. I hope Watarai can come tomorrow. She’s always been the kind of person who brightens a room just by being there.”

lines.japanese: 「ほとんど遊んでたから、作業は進まなかったけどね。あはは」
lines.english: “Though we spent nearly the whole time fooling around, so we didn't get much work done. Ahaha.”

lines.japanese: でも確かに楽しかったなあ。先週末、三人で遊びに出たのも、渡来さんが外へ行こうって言いだしたからだっけ。
lines.english: But it certainly had been fun. Come to think of it, when the three of us went out last weekend, Watarai was the one who suggested it.

lines.japanese: 山科さんの言う通り、彼女は不思議とそこにいるだけで場を明るくするような、そんな空気を持っていた。
lines.english: Yamashina was right. Watarai had a mysterious presence about her, something that brightened a room simply by being there.

lines.japanese: いつか森里君たちが冗談で言ってた。彼女は僕らと違う、そういう人種だって。
lines.english: Morisato and the others had once said it as a joke: she was a different breed from people like us.

lines.japanese: 「また全員揃ったらゲームセンター行こうか」
lines.english: “When everyone's here again, shall we go to the arcade?”

lines.japanese: 気がつくと机の上は綺麗に片付けられていた。山科さんが教室を出てゆく。
lines.english: Before I knew it, the tabletop was spotless and everything had been put away. Yamashina left the classroom.

lines.japanese: 一人残った僕は、なんとはなしに渡来さんの机を見ていた。体調はどのくらい悪いんだろうか。明日には回復できるといいな。
lines.english: Left alone, I found myself gazing for no particular reason at Watarai's desk. How sick was she? I hoped she would be better by tomorrow.

lines.japanese: 渡来さんみたいなひとは、体の細胞から違う作りをしてて、いつでも体調なんて崩さないと思ってた。そんなわけないのに。
lines.english: I had somehow imagined that people like Watarai were made differently down to the cells of their bodies, that they simply never got sick. As if that could possibly be true.

lines.japanese: 僕は彼女のさまざまな表情を思いだしながら、無人の机に笑顔を作ってみせた。
lines.english: Remembering all the expressions I had seen on her face, I made myself smile at the empty desk.

lines.japanese: 笑っていれば楽しいことはきっとあるんじゃないかな
lines.english: If you keep smiling, something fun is bound to come along.
